description: This file defines a centralized router class for a Flutter mobile application, managing navigation routes and generating route widgets for different app screens. It also includes a stub screen widget for navigation testing purposes.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A class that manages the application's route names and provides a method to generate appropriate page routes based on route settings.

classes.name: _StubScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget used as a placeholder screen for testing navigation, displaying route info and navigation options.

classes.name: _NavButton
classes.description: A reusable widget representing a button that navigates to a specified route when pressed.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Generates a MaterialPageRoute based on the route name, including setting up the page widget to display.
